Google Ads Performance

Paid Search Driving Leases

Across the 14 communities running Google Ads in September, paid search delivered strong lead volume at an efficient cost. Campaigns span brand, floor-plan, and location-based search, plus Performance Max and Demand Gen. Figures below exclude one community with a conversion-tracking error (see note) so the portfolio picture reflects reality. One metric jumps off the page: search click-through rate averaged 17.0% across the portfolio — roughly three times the typical 4–6% for search ads.

Reading This Report · Data Note
Three accounts need a conversion-tracking fix
Willows at Ventura reports a 290.9% conversion rate and 4,680 conversions — impossible, and a sign its tracking is multi-counting each lead. It is excluded from the portfolio totals and highlights above so the numbers stay honest. Paseos Ontario and River Ranch Townhomes show almost no conversions despite solid click volume, which usually means their conversion tracking isn't firing. All three are flagged in the table and should be audited before next month.

What's Included in Google Ads Management

  • Full-funnel campaign build across Search, Performance Max, and Demand Gen
  • Brand, floor-plan, and location-based search campaigns
  • Dynamic Search and broad-match coverage for the long tail
  • Conversion tracking setup and lead attribution
  • Ongoing bid, budget, and keyword optimization
  • Ad copy and creative development per community
  • Landing page and floor-plan page alignment
  • Monthly performance reporting by community

Execution Process

A Simple Process For Ongoing Growth

Every community running Google Ads follows the same cycle each month, designed to find opportunities, ship optimizations, track movement, and continually refine based on results.

1
Audit

Review account structure, keyword and search-term performance, negatives, impression share, and competitor activity.

2
Optimize

Adjust bids, budgets, and negatives, refresh ad copy and creative, and align landing pages by community.

3
Track

Monitor spend, leads, cost per lead, conversion-tracking health, and search impression share.

4
Scale

Reallocate budget to top-performing communities, expand winning campaigns, and prioritize next steps.
